question: Which three years in 2012-2017 have the smallest absolute difference between median revenue and median functional expenses for organizations filing IRS 990 forms? Please output three years and respective differences.
sql:
WITH all_data AS (
  SELECT '2012' AS year, totrevenue AS rev, totfuncexpns AS expns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2012` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2012'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2013', totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2013` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2013'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2014', totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2014` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2014'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2015', totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2015` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2015'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2016', totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2016` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2016'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT '2017', totrevenue, totfuncexpns FROM `bigquery-public-data.irs_990.irs_990_2017` WHERE SAFE_CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(tax_pd AS STRING), 1, 4) AS STRING) = '2017'
),
ranked_rev AS (
  SELECT year, rev, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY rev) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS cnt
  FROM all_data
  WHERE rev IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_exp AS (
  SELECT year, expns, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY expns) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY year) AS cnt
  FROM all_data
  WHERE expns IS NOT NULL
),
median_rev AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(rev) AS median_revenue
  FROM ranked_rev
  WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2.0), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2.0))
  GROUP BY year
),
median_exp AS (
  SELECT year, AVG(expns) AS median_funcexpns
  FROM ranked_exp
  WHERE rn IN (FLOOR((cnt + 1) / 2.0), CEIL((cnt + 1) / 2.0))
  GROUP BY year
),
combined AS (
  SELECT 
    mr.year,
    mr.median_revenue,
    me.median_funcexpns,
    ABS(mr.median_revenue - me.median_funcexpns) AS abs_diff
  FROM median_rev mr
  JOIN median_exp me ON mr.year = me.year
)
SELECT year, abs_diff
FROM combined
ORDER BY abs_diff
LIMIT 3
